title: Mars magazine cover
description: A headline that sits behind the subject.
note: The parts of the headline hidden behind the helmet were filled in. The ground behind the astronaut is generated.

title: Festival flyer
description: Text printed over a photo, plus a sticker badge.
note: The crowd under the sticker was filled in. Stage and crowd details were redrawn and differ from the original.

title: Coffee bag ad
description: A product, props, and a headline on one surface.
note: The beans came back as one group layer. The cup lost most of its cast shadow.

title: Food sticker sheet
description: Nine stickers on a white sheet.
note: Each sticker is its own layer and keeps its white border.

title: Sneaker sale poster
description: A product lying across large type.
note: The digits under the sneaker were filled in. The sneaker lost its drop shadow, and its toe is still cut off at the edge.

title: Missing cat flyer
description: A photo, handwritten lines, and tear-off tabs.
note: The photo, each text line, and each tab are separate layers. Tab edges were redrawn.

title: Four-product flat lay
description: Four products on a plain backdrop.
note: Each product is its own layer. Their cast shadows were not kept.

title: Soda can ad
description: A can with fruit, ice, and a splash around it.
note: The lime wedge in front of the can came back behind it, and the splash was redrawn. Layer order is shown as returned.

title: Game item sheet
description: Four hand-painted items in a row.
note: Four items, four layers. The white background kept faint grey marks.

title: Rainy street illustration
description: A character between a foreground prop and a busy street.
note: The girl and her umbrella are one layer. Her face and clothing were redrawn, and her reflection stays on the ground when she moves.

title: Sunlit coastal stairs
description: A coastal stairway split into background, cat and schoolgirl layers.
note: The girl and cat are separate layers. Background areas behind them are generated, so fine textures and outlines can differ from the input.

title: Golden hour seaside window
description: A seaside interior separated into background and individual scene elements.
note: The scene is split into 15 layers. Tabletop lighting, shadows and small details were redrawn; the composite is not pixel-identical to the input.

title: Viking kitten parts
description: A helmeted kitten separated into face, eyes, horns, fur trim and cloak parts.
note: Eyes, muzzle, helmet, horns and cloak are separate raster pieces. The face, neck and cloak were redrawn; the output is not a rigged character.
